description: This file defines an API endpoint class EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It handles HTTP requests related to employee leave entitlements, including fetching individual entitlement details and listing entitlements for multiple employees. The class integrates with various services and models, and includes detailed API documentation annotations (Swagger/OpenAPI) for its endpoints.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI
classes.description: A class providing REST API endpoints for managing and retrieving employee leave entitlement data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a specific employee's leave entitlement based on employee number and query parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list leave entitlements for multiple employees, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.description: Method to create a new leave entitlement; not implemented in this class.

methods.description: Method to update an existing leave entitlement; not implemented in this class.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method to delete a leave entitlement; not implemented in this class.
